content.text: 四晚住在四条河原町附近，每天只去一片区域：早上出门早，下午慢下来。点下面的某一天看路线。

days.label: 第 1 天
days.title: 稻荷与夜祇园
days.summary: 下午到，先去千本鸟居，晚上在祇园和先斗町慢慢走。

stops.name: 京都站
stops.note: 到站先把大件行李寄到酒店或放进车站寄存柜，轻装出发。

stops.name: 伏见稻荷大社
stops.note: 千本鸟居。走到四辻观景点再下来，大约 1.5–2 小时，量力而行。

leg.text: JR 奈良线，京都站 → 稻荷站

stops.name: 祇园白川
stops.note: 傍晚沿白川走，柳树、石板路和小桥。

leg.text: 京阪线，伏见稻荷 → 祇园四条

stops.name: 花见小路
stops.note: 茶屋街。部分私人小巷禁止拍照，留意路口告示。

stops.name: 先斗町
stops.note: 鸭川边的窄巷，晚饭就在这里；热门的店提前订。

days.label: 第 2 天
days.title: 东山的清晨
days.summary: 全天步行。早起赶在人潮之前上清水寺，下坡一路逛回祇园。

stops.name: 清水寺
stops.note: 开门很早。先到清水舞台，再看音羽瀑布。

leg.text: 市巴士到清水道，再上坡步行

stops.name: 三年坂·二年坂
stops.note: 石阶老街，店铺还没开门的时候最安静。

stops.name: 高台寺
stops.note: 庭园和一小段竹林；旁边的石塀小路值得绕一下。

stops.name: 八坂神社
stops.note: 穿过圆山公园过来，西楼门正对四条通。

stops.name: 建仁寺
stops.note: 午饭后来这里，坐在方丈廊下对着枯山水发呆。

days.label: 第 3 天
days.title: 岚山到金阁
days.summary: 上午在西边的竹林和河边，下午坐岚电往北看两座名寺。

stops.name: 竹林小径
stops.note: 早上八点前人少，光线也最柔和。

leg.text: 阪急线（桂站换乘）到岚山，过桥步行

stops.name: 天龙寺
stops.note: 曹源池庭园；北门和竹林小径相通。

stops.name: 渡月桥
stops.note: 过桥看保津川和岚山，午饭在附近解决。

stops.name: 龙安寺
stops.note: 石庭十五块石头，从任何角度都看不全。

leg.text: 岚电，帷子之辻换乘到龙安寺站

stops.name: 金阁寺
stops.note: 下午阳光照在金阁上；傍晚前关门，别拖太晚。

leg.text: 沿衣笠山脚的绢挂之路

days.label: 第 4 天
days.title: 哲学之道与锦市场
days.summary: 沿水渠走一上午，下午回到市中心吃吃逛逛，傍晚坐在鸭川边。

stops.name: 银阁寺
stops.note: 银沙滩和向月台；绕后山小路可以看到半个京都。

stops.name: 哲学之道
stops.note: 沿水渠约 2 公里，春天是樱花，秋天是红叶。

stops.name: 南禅寺
stops.note: 可以登三门；红砖的水路阁就在寺内。

stops.name: 锦市场
stops.note: 边逛边尝。在买的店门口吃完，别边走边吃。

leg.text: 地铁东西线，蹴上 → 京都市役所前

stops.name: 鸭川河岸
stops.note: 三条到四条之间的河岸坐一会儿，看天慢慢暗下来。

days.label: 第 5 天
days.title: 奈良一日
days.summary: 坐近铁去奈良，鹿、大佛和春日大社，傍晚回京都。

stops.name: 近铁奈良站
stops.note: 京都站坐近铁京都线，急行约 45 分钟。

stops.name: 兴福寺
stops.note: 出站几分钟就到；国宝馆里有阿修罗像。

stops.name: 东大寺
stops.note: 大佛殿是世界上最大的木造建筑之一，里面是大佛。

stops.name: 奈良公园·鹿
stops.note: 公园里有卖鹿饼。地图和纸袋收好，鹿会咬。

stops.name: 春日大社
stops.note: 参道两旁是石灯笼，林子里很凉快。

stops.name: 奈良町
stops.note: 老町屋街区，喝杯茶再回京都。

inset.title: 奈良 · 近铁约 45 分

labels.overviewHint: 悬停一天看它在地图上的位置，点进去看当天路线。
labels.dayHint: 悬停或点按站点，地图跟着走
labels.mapCaption: 示意地图 · 相对位置按真实经纬度，奈良为插图

content.text: 大概要花多少
两个人先按商务酒店算；想住一晚町屋或旅馆，切换一下就知道差多少。

tiers.name: 传统旅馆
tiers.note: 榻榻米房，住一两晚体验就好

labels.note: 示例价格，仅供估算：房价按两人一间计；吃饭和交通按天数（晚数 + 1）计；不含机票。

content.text: 出发前
要订的
机票，以及到京都的交通
四晚住宿（四条河原町附近）
先斗町那顿晚饭
查一下想去的寺院有没有特别参观要预约
旅行保险
要带的
好走的鞋，每天至少走一两万步
零钱包：小店和寺社常常只收现金
没破洞的袜子，寺里要脱鞋
一个折叠袋，路上垃圾桶很少
充电宝
一件薄外套，早晚温差大
知道一下
IC 卡一张走天下
ICOCA 之类的交通 IC 卡（或手机钱包里的交通卡）能坐京都的巴士、地铁和电车，也能坐近铁去奈良，便利店也能刷。
早起比什么都管用
伏见稻荷全天开放，竹林和清水寺一早去人最少。把热门景点放在上午，下午留给喝茶和散步。
很多寺院大约早上 8–9 点开门、傍晚 4–5 点停止入场，冬季更早；具体以官网为准，出发前一周再核对一次。
舞伎、艺伎是在工作的人，不要拦下拍照或跟随。部分私人小巷禁止拍照，留意路口告示。
鹿饼在公园里就有卖。鹿会顶人、咬纸，地图和购物袋收进包里，鹿饼拿完就给，别逗。

components.name: Trip route map
components.description: Day tabs over a schematic SVG map: pick a day to zoom to its ordered stops, legs and travel times.
scenarios: Plan a multi-day city trip with one route per day.
Show walking routes or tours on a hand-drawn style map without map tiles.

boundaries: Multi-day itineraries with up to 10 days and 12 stops per day on one schematic map plus one inset.
Positions are author-projected map coordinates; there are no map tiles or geocoding.

usage.purpose: Let travellers see the whole trip at once, then follow one day's route stop by stop on a map.
structure: Tabs: an overview tab plus one tab per day.
Left: overview day rows, or the selected day's summary, ordered stops with leg chips and totals.
Right: SVG map with hills, rivers, a street grid, district labels, base marker, inset, routes and numbered pins.

inputs.meaning: Trip days in order; each becomes a tab after the overview tab.
Stable day id, unique among days.
Day theme shown on the tab and overview row.
One-sentence plan shown above the stop list.
Day colour (#RRGGBB) for its tab, route, pins and list accents.
Stable stop id, unique within its day.
Place name shown in the list and the map label.
District or area name shown beside the place.
Planned arrival time as free text, e.g. 09:30.
Practical note revealed when the stop is active.
Map x position in map coordinates (0..map.width, east is +).
Map y position in map coordinates (0..map.height, south is +).
How to get to this stop from the previous one (or from map.base for the first stop).

omission.description: No leg: the stop starts the day and no route segment is drawn to it.

inputs.meaning: walk, train or bus; walk draws a dotted line, bus dashed, train solid.
Approximate travel minutes; summed into the day totals.
Schematic base map in its own coordinate space.
Width of the map coordinate space; the SVG keeps this aspect ratio.
Height of the map coordinate space.
Filled green polygons for hills or parks.
Rectangle filled with a faint street grid (downtown).
District labels drawn on the map.
Primary district label, unique among districts.
Where the travellers stay; first legs start here.
Framed inset for a day trip drawn at a different scale; stops inside it use inset positions.
Scale bar for the main map.
Length of the scale bar in map units at full zoom.
Minute template; {n} is replaced by the number.
Hint in the day totals line.
Caption under the map, also its accessible name.

recipes.title: English trip
steps: Project each place to map x/y.

interactions.action: Click a day tab (arrow keys move between tabs)
interactions.effect: Map animates to that day's stops; list shows its route.

interactions.action: Hover a day row in the overview
Hover, focus or click a stop or pin
interactions.effect: Expands its note and labels the pin.

interactions.action: Click a faint dot from another day

constraints: Coordinates share one space with map.width × map.height; inset stops use positions inside map.inset.
Minutes are approximate and only summed per mode.

data: days: Trip days in order; each becomes a tab after the overview tab.
map: Schematic base map in its own coordinate space.
implementation: Keep dayTotals() and readData in sync.
Pins and labels are scaled by the current zoom so they stay a constant size.

entryPoints.purpose: React entry: tabs, list, SVG map, zoom animation and readData.

architecture: Selected day and active stop are local view state; nothing is written back.
fitBox() computes a viewBox for the selected day's stops; useAnimatedBox() eases between viewBoxes.
extensionPoints: Add more leg modes with their own dash patterns.
Add more insets for further day trips.
invariants: Overview shows the full map; day views never zoom past 30% of map width.
verification: Click each tab and check pins stay inside the view.
Hover stops and check the pin label follows.

days.label: Day 1
days.title: Inari & Gion at night
days.summary: Arrive after lunch, walk the torii tunnels, then drift through Gion after dark.

stops.name: Kyoto Station
stops.note: Send big bags ahead to the hotel or use station lockers, then travel light.

stops.name: Fushimi Inari Taisha
stops.note: The torii tunnels. Up to the Yotsutsuji lookout and back is roughly 1.5–2 h.

stops.name: Gion Shirakawa
stops.note: Willows, stone paving and little bridges along the canal at dusk.

stops.name: Hanamikoji
stops.note: Teahouse street. Some private lanes ban photos — check the signs.

stops.name: Pontochō
stops.note: Dinner in the narrow lane by the Kamo River; book popular places ahead.

days.label: Day 2
days.title: Higashiyama, early
days.summary: A walking day. Beat the crowds up to Kiyomizu, then wander downhill back to Gion.

stops.name: Kiyomizu-dera
stops.note: Opens early. The wooden stage first, then the Otowa spring.

leg.text: City bus to Kiyomizu-michi, then uphill

stops.name: Sannenzaka & Ninenzaka
stops.note: Stone-stepped lanes, quietest before the shops open.

stops.name: Kōdai-ji
stops.note: Gardens and a short bamboo path; detour through Ishibe-kōji lane next door.

stops.name: Yasaka Shrine
stops.note: Through Maruyama Park; the west gate faces Shijō-dōri.

stops.name: Kennin-ji
stops.note: After lunch: sit on the veranda facing the dry garden for a while.

days.label: Day 3
days.title: Arashiyama to Kinkaku-ji
days.summary: Bamboo and river in the west all morning; the little Randen tram north after lunch.

stops.name: Bamboo grove
stops.note: Before 8 a.m. it's calm and the light is soft.

leg.text: Hankyu via Katsura, then over the bridge

stops.name: Tenryū-ji
stops.note: The Sōgen pond garden; its north gate opens onto the bamboo path.

stops.name: Togetsukyō Bridge
stops.note: Cross for river-and-mountain views; lunch nearby.

stops.name: Ryōan-ji
stops.note: The rock garden: fifteen stones, never all visible at once.

stops.name: Kinkaku-ji
stops.note: Afternoon sun on the gold; it closes before evening, so don't linger.

days.label: Day 4
days.title: Philosopher's Path & Nishiki
days.summary: A canal-side morning, a grazing afternoon downtown, sunset on the Kamo.

stops.name: Ginkaku-ji
stops.note: Sand garden, then the hillside path for a view over the city.

stops.name: Philosopher's Path
stops.note: About 2 km along a canal — cherry blossom in spring, maples in autumn.

stops.name: Nanzen-ji
stops.note: Climb the Sanmon gate; the brick aqueduct runs through the grounds.

leg.text: Walk the path to its south end

stops.name: Nishiki Market
stops.note: Graze your way through — eat at the stall, not while walking.

stops.name: Kamo riverbank
stops.note: Sit on the bank between Sanjō and Shijō as the light fades.

days.label: Day 5
days.title: A day in Nara
days.summary: Kintetsu to Nara for deer, the Great Buddha and Kasuga; back to Kyoto by evening.

stops.name: Kintetsu-Nara Station
stops.note: Kintetsu Kyoto Line from Kyoto Station, about 45 min by express.

leg.text: Subway to Kyoto Station, then Kintetsu

stops.name: Kōfuku-ji
stops.note: A few minutes from the station; the National Treasure Hall holds the Ashura statue.

stops.name: Tōdai-ji
stops.note: The Great Buddha Hall, one of the largest wooden buildings in the world.

stops.name: Nara Park deer
stops.note: Deer crackers are sold in the park. Keep maps and paper bags tucked away.

stops.name: Kasuga Taisha
stops.note: Stone lanterns line the approach through the forest.

stops.name: Naramachi
stops.note: Old merchant-house streets; tea, then the train back.

labels.dayHint: Hover or tap a stop to find it on the map
labels.mapCaption: Schematic map · positions from real coordinates; Nara shown as an inset

components.name: Trip budget
components.description: Adjust travellers, nights and lodging tier to see an approximate per-person trip cost with a breakdown.
scenarios: Compare lodging tiers for a group.

boundaries: Simple trip cost: room price shared per room plus per-day and per-trip personal items, one currency.

usage.purpose: Give travellers a quick, honest per-person estimate they can adjust together.
structure: Left: people stepper, nights slider, tier cards.
Right: per-person total, group and per-day figures, stacked bar and breakdown list, note.

inputs.meaning: Initial traveller count (between min and max).
People per room; rooms = ceil(people / roomCapacity).
Stable tier id, unique among tiers.
Price per room per night in the display currency.
Stable item id, unique among items (not 'lodging').
Per-person amount in the display currency.
day multiplies by days (nights + 1); trip counts once.
Room count template; {n} is the number of rooms.
Money template; {v} is the rounded amount with thousands separators.
Line shown under the tiers when the cheapest tier is selected.
Line comparing with the cheapest tier; {v} is the per-person difference, {tier} the cheapest tier name.

interactions.action: Step people, drag nights, choose a tier
interactions.effect: Totals and bar update; saved as new initial values only while editing.

constraints: Prices are inputs, not live data; label them as illustrative in labels.note.
people.value and nights.value stay within their ranges.

data: roomCapacity: People per room; rooms = ceil(people / roomCapacity).
tiers: Lodging choices shown as cards.
lodgingColor: Colour of the lodging segment (#RRGGBB).
implementation: Keep estimate() and readData in sync.

architecture: Local state mirrors people/nights/tier; onChange persists when not read-only.
extensionPoints: Add a currency conversion line with an explicit rate input.
invariants: Lodging per person = ceil(people / roomCapacity) × rate × nights ÷ people; day items × (nights + 1).
verification: Default 2 people, 4 nights, business hotel gives ¥77,600 per person.
